blurb: Pleasure Cove Marina offers a variety of rental boats including pontoons, center console fishing boats, ski boats, and personal watercraft for activities like tubing, tanning, cruising, relaxing, and fishing. The marina operates on Lake Berryessa, a large freshwater lake with over 165 miles of shoreline, popular for year-round recreation and fishing.

quotes.author: Matt Steinmetz
quotes.text: We booked an RV site and it was a good size spot. Didn't feel crowded even with other RVs next door. Staff was friendly and we enjoyed the weekend.

quotes.author: Brian Taylor
quotes.text: I have friends who work and live there. Beautiful lake and friendly staff. Grounds are kept up fairly well.

quotes.author: Janet Arriaga
quotes.text: Great staff. They helped us when we asked and they were great at guiding us on local food places!

quotes.author: Mario Briones
quotes.text: We had a great time. We go every year at least once and have always been pleased.
